name: Ex-gratia Payment for the Construction Workers
benefit: - Ex-gratia payment of ₹1,00,000/- in case of permanent disability.
_eligibility_text: > **For Registration** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year. **For Application** - The applicant should be permanently disabled.
